record.field:
Lists all students filtered by university, college, department, program or academic period. Outputs a printable PDF or Excel file with student code, name, program and contact information.
NOTE: This report requires the ``university_student`` module to be installed in order to produce non-empty output. The template itself installs cleanly without that dependency because the target model name is stored as a free-text Char field and resolved lazily at report-run time.

Batch transcript summary showing issued transcripts for the selected period. Includes student identity, cumulative GPA, credits earned and academic standing.
NOTE: This report requires the ``university_gradebook`` module to be installed in order to produce non-empty output. The template itself installs cleanly without that dependency because the target model name is stored as a free-text Char field and resolved lazily at report-run time.

Financial summary showing invoices, amounts billed, paid and outstanding for the selected period and scope.
NOTE: This report requires the ``university_finance`` module to be installed in order to produce non-empty output. The template itself installs cleanly without that dependency because the target model name is stored as a free-text Char field and resolved lazily at report-run time.

Enrollment statistics by program, academic term and level. Shows enrollment counts, total credits attempted and average GPA per cohort.
NOTE: This report requires the ``university_student`` module to be installed in order to produce non-empty output. The template itself installs cleanly without that dependency because the target model name is stored as a free-text Char field and resolved lazily at report-run time.

Distribution of academic standing (excellent / good / probation / dismissed) across the selected scope. Highlights students at risk for academic intervention.
NOTE: This report requires the ``university_student`` module to be installed in order to produce non-empty output. The template itself installs cleanly without that dependency because the target model name is stored as a free-text Char field and resolved lazily at report-run time.
